summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF LOUISIANA.

The case is stated in the opinion.
attorneys: Mr. P. Phillips for plaintiff in error., Mr. Louis Janin for defendants in error.

opinions.author: Chase
opinions.text:
Mr. Chief Justice Chase

delivered the opinion of-the court.

Mr. P. Phillips for plaintiff in error. Mr. Louis Janin for defendants in error.

I am instructed by the cqurt to say that the decision in Bethell v. Demaret, 10 Wall. 537, decided at this term, is regarded as governing this case.

The writ of error must therefore be dismissed.
